UNITED STATES OF AMERICA GENERAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION
Public Buildings Service Washington, DC 20405
AUG 2 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger Acting Area Office Director Department of Housing and Urban Development 15 New Chardon Street Boston, Massachusetts 02114
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
The General Services Administration has reviewed the draft environmental impact statement for the Department of Housing and Urban Development -Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and have no substantive comments to make.
Thank you for the opportunity to comment.
Sincerely,
(signed) Gary D. Roberts
ANDREW E. KAUDERS
Director, Environmental Affairs Division Special Studies and Programs Office
